resourceBehavior.finding: ESActivity pause/stop/destroy, or another Activity resume, invalidates sessions. Surface and SurfaceTexture are released synchronously; MediaPlayer release runs on its worker. The idle watchdog is removed. Native policy selects one live decoder despite four slot containers. Hidden menu frames may remain as bounded GPU previews; they are not active players.
Pause/stop/other Activity suspends playback, releases the player, abandons audio focus and removes the watchdog. Its HandlerThread can remain idle.

The verified ES lifecycle forwards visibility to StationFrontend and SDL. Automatic catalog refresh and cover requests are cancelled while hidden. Native menu animations are driven by draw calls rather than independent timers. Explicit user downloads can continue through their existing service. No emulator loop was changed or measured.

Activity stop cancels polling, requests and artwork; destruction closes executors and bitmap cache. Hyperspace/rating animations require resumed state, attachment, visibility and focus. Button motion remains limited to ABRIR/VOLTAR labels and stops on loss of focus/visibility. Cached view assets can remain while a stopped Activity stays in the back stack.

v2 intentionally pauses the native game and closes remote transport while retaining session membership. A 20-second authority heartbeat remains; explicit human exit closes membership. These semantics must be preserved by navigation fixes. A cached process without an Activity is not proof of ongoing emulation.

separateOptimizationFindings.scope: R71 v2 only; cannot explain the reported R70 navigation behavior
separateOptimizationFindings.finding: The 250ms scheduled tick remains active after visible(false); pump calls nativeStatus before rejecting a null remote. This causes bounded periodic worker/JNI work while hidden, although the game is paused.
separateOptimizationFindings.action: Documented only. No timer, heartbeat or recovery change authorized in this audit.

separateOptimizationFindings.scope: Panels inside the same visible R71 Rooms Activity
separateOptimizationFindings.finding: paint reconstructs room/player views and can request room cover art even when their panels are GONE. Activity-level cancellation still works. This is avoidable hidden-panel work, not proof of two actively rendering Activities.
separateOptimizationFindings.action: Documented only; navigation correction must not disturb authoritative room polling.

limitations: This audit proves source/module identity and explicit lifecycle behavior, not actual CPU/GPU consumption on the current phone.
Older private CPU snapshots were not used as evidence of current activity.
No Android tests, gameplay tests, device interaction, build, installation or runtime modifications were performed.
